title: Best Workout Apps to Pair with Your NZ Gym Membership
meta_desc: Discover the best workout apps to pair with your NZ gym membership, including free and paid options
intro: With a wide range of workout apps available, Kiwis can enhance their gym experience without breaking the bank. For example, a membership at Les Mills Auckland costs around $34.95 per week, and pairing it with their On Demand app can be a great way to stay motivated. Many NZ gyms offer affordable membership options, such as Jetts Gym at $16.95 per week, and $149.95 for a 12-month contract

sections.heading: Free Workout Apps for NZ Gym Goers
sections.body: If you're looking for a free workout app to complement your NZ gym membership, there are several options available. The Nike Training Club app offers a range of workouts, from strength training to cardio, and is completely free to download and use. Another option is the JEFIT app, which has a large exercise database and allows you to create and customize your own workouts.

sections.heading: Paid Workout Apps for NZ Gym Members
list: Les Mills On Demand: $14.95 per month

sections.heading: How to Choose the Best Workout App for Your NZ Gym Membership
sections.body: When choosing a workout app to pair with your NZ gym membership, consider your fitness goals and what type of workouts you enjoy. If you prefer group fitness classes, Les Mills On Demand may be a great option. If you prefer personalized workouts, Fitstar may be a better fit.

sections.heading: Jetts Gym Membership and App Bundle
sections.body: Jetts Gym offers a membership and app bundle for $149.95 for a 12-month contract, which includes access to their gyms and a range of workout apps. This can be a great option for those who want a hassle-free fitness experience.
